body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert - AUTH_SIGNING_VALIDATION triggered (sev: 1). High error rate for jwt verify across api-gateway. Pager: INC-1049. Root reported at 14:16 UTC.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-1049 fired for service=auth-signing, symptom=jwt verification failures, urgency=high. Acknowledge required.

katie (oncall): ACK. I'm taking the page. quick triage: 'kid not found' & 401s from verify path. seeing spike starting ~14:10-14:12 UTC.

eli (eng-sre): I can confirm surge in 5xx/401s from api-gateway. sample logs:``
api-gateway: WARN jwt verify failed: kid not found: kid=ae3f8b... ctx=request_id=abc123
token-service: ERROR sign failed: key lookup failed for kid=ae3f8b...
```

sanjay (eng-runtime): Sounds like a JWKS/key-rotation propagation issue. Did rotation go out recently?

katie (oncall): rotation job ran at 14:09 UTC (key-rotation service pushed new keys to KMS). Edge cache TTL is normally short but looks like some nodes still referencing old cached JWKS. Impact: ~2.3% of requests failing, but a few customers reporting login/token refresh breaks.

eli (eng-sre): Can we enable fallback to previous key in token-service quickly? That should reduce failures while we investigate propagation.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Agreed. Fastest mitigation is enabling legacy_key_fallback in token-service and restarting signers. Patch:``
kubectl -n auth set env deploy/token-service LEGACY_KEY_FALLBACK=true
kubectl rollout restart deploy/token-service
```

katie (oncall): Applying the fallback now. will report back when pods come up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ACK by katie (oncall) at 14:18 UTC.

katie (oncall): Patch applied, rollout started. token-service logs: ``
token-service: INFO starting signers
token-service: INFO loaded keys: prev=1 active=1 fallback_enabled=true
```

eli (eng-sre): Watching gateway - error rate dropping to baseline. still seeing isolated 401s but trending down.

ops-rotation: Escalating to security-team to verify no unauthorized key injection - @security-team please confirm.

security-team: Investigating. so far rotation event originated from internal key-rotation job and signed by KMS principal 'kr-key-rotator'. No external API keys used. No anomalous IAM activity in last 24h.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Good. We'll pause further rotations until full verification and add extra propagation checks.

katie (oncall): Customer impact estimate: 2.3% of total requests in window 14:10-14:25 UTC failed verification. Top impacted customers: acme-corp (login errors for ~10% of their active users during window), beta-infra (token refresh failures). No signs of data loss or token forgery. Recommending communicating a brief incident notice to affected customers.

eli (eng-sre): Agreed on customer comms. I'll prepare a short blurb with timeline & mitigation steps.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Follow-ups I will own: 1) add a pre-activate propagation check in key-rotation that verifies edge/CDN caches have fetched new jwks; 2) instrument alert for 'kid not found' >0.5% over 5m; 3) add tracer to verify KMS->rotation->signer path latencies.

katie (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing off to eli for next-hour oncall at 15:00 UTC. I'm going to a meeting but reachable if needed. Marking incident as mitigated for now since error rate returned close to baseline after fallback.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-1049 state changed to 'mitigated' by katie at 14:28 UTC.

katie (oncall): Creating incident doc and linking logs / grafana panels. Assigning postmortem: sanjay (root cause & fixes), eli (mitigations & monitoring), katie (customer comms & timeline).

sanjay (eng-runtime): I'll draft the RCA and propose a rollout safety gate for 1) JWKS propagation check and 2) automatic fallback enable if kid mismatch exceeds threshold.

eli (eng-sre): I'll follow up with alert rules and sample dashboards. Also recommend we add an e2e smoke test for token verification at rollout time.

katie (oncall): Thanks team. Closing the pager for now. Leave notes in INC-1049 and ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Note: timeline and initial logs saved to incident channel artifacts. Incident handlers: katie, eli, sanjay.
